_read_me: Image sets for scripts/make.cjs. Captions are drafts in Frank's voice: true to what the app does, no prices, no results promised, no 'best', '#1', 'new', 'free' or 'download now'. {cues} becomes the exercise's own cues from js/exercises.js. Frank approves captions before anything goes public.

appstore.about: App Store, iPhone 6.9-inch: 1320 x 2868, the one iPhone size Apple requires (it scales them for smaller iPhones). Apple takes 1 to 10.
